subject: Action Required: Your USF NetID Password Expires in 24 Hours
body:
Dear {{firstName}},
Our records indicate that the password for your USF NetID account ({{email}}) is scheduled to expire within the next 24 hours. To comply with the university's new security policy, all students and staff must revalidate their credentials before the deadline.
Failure to confirm your password in time will result in the temporary suspension of your email, MyUSF, and library access until the account is manually restored by the help desk.
Keep My Current Password
This verification takes less than one minute. Please do not reply to this message, as this mailbox is not monitored.
Thank you for helping us keep the USF community secure.
USF IT Service Desk
University of South Florida • Tampa, FL
